{{Top}}
'''Signal beacons''' were part of the standard equipment aboard [[Lictor-class dungeon ship|''Lictor''-class dungeon ships]]. They were located in the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] module situated on the underside of the ship; in case of emergency, such as a prisoner revolt, the entire command chamber could detach to protect the crew and deprive the escapees of a way to control the ship. The signal beacon allowed for rescue.
